name: Firefox Quick Dictionary
description: Instant Merriam-Webster definitions for highlighted or right-clicked words, with adaptive page-aware themes, pin, copy, keyboard shortcut, and toolbar search.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; img-src 'self' https://dictionaryapi.com data:; connect-src 'self' https://www.dictionaryapi.com https://media.merriam-webster.com

open-quick-dictionary.description: Define the selected word or open Firefox Quick Dictionary search
